name: Test room 5 — shoulder carry
notes: Milestone 3b. Land on your partner’s head to ride their shoulders: you move with them wherever they walk, jump or crouch (the carrier is 30% slower). Jump to leave, or walk off the edge. WALL 1 is a 4-tall slab over a tunnel whose door is shut: one player stands on the other’s head and jumps up onto the slab, then flips the switch on top, which opens the door for the carrier to walk through underneath. WALL 2 is the same at 6 tall: the CHAINED BOOST — the carrier jumps and, while rising, the rider jumps off them for a much higher jump. Then both walk to the exit. A carrier who starts drawing is frozen and the rider just stands on them; if either dies the carry ends. Solo (Tab) can do wall 1 but not the chained boost.
hint: Shoulder carry. Jump onto your partner’s head to ride along. Wall 1: stand on their head, jump up onto the wall, flip the switch (E / /) to open its door for them. Wall 2: they jump, you jump off them while they are rising.
